description: This file defines the interface for the SNMP Adapter module in a TR181 device management context. It includes class declarations, external file references, and method signatures related to SNMP operations.

classes.name: hostIf_snmpAdapter
classes.description: Provides an interface for SNMP device information retrieval and management, including instance handling, locking, and SNMP get/set operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes SNMP adapter instances and resources.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: Uninitializes and releases SNMP adapter resources.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of the SNMP adapter for a given device ID.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and releases a specific SNMP adapter instance.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all SNMP adapter instances.

methods.name: getLock
methods.description: Acquires a lock for thread-safe operations.

methods.name: get_ValueFromSNMPAdapter
methods.description: Performs SNMP GET operation for device parameters.

methods.name: set_ValueToSNMPAdapter
methods.description: Performs SNMP SET operation for device parameters.
